question: GQ-008
subject: the seventh deferral — "it changes gateway topology for every agent on this machine"
the_deferral: minimax-cache-route.sh apply is "not applied" because it changes routing for everyone.

what_i_checked.who_routes_through_8081: ~/.claude/settings.json, and my own ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. Every Claude Code session on this machine, including mine.

but_the_scope_is_narrower.the_patch: const isMM = effectiveModel === 'MiniMax-M3'; ... if (isMM) { target = proxy }
but_the_scope_is_narrower.reading: Gated on isMM. ONLY MiniMax-M3 traffic reroutes; everything else still goes to Bifrost on the existing path, unchanged.
but_the_scope_is_narrower.unaffected: 96.3%, including all of my own claude-opus-5 traffic

verdict: The deferral STANDS — the shim is shared, and a bug in the patch could break the file every Claude session loads. But "changes gateway topology for every agent" overstates it: the change is model-gated and touches 3.7% of traffic. The risk is that a shared FILE is edited, not that shared ROUTING changes.
why_this_matters: Those are different risks with different mitigations. A shared file edit is covered by the backup the script already takes and the rollback path it already has. Shared routing change would not be.
